title: DC-area forecast: Summerlike through Friday, then cooler and wetter into the weekend
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Temperatures fall into the 60s overnight on the way to lows in the low and mid-60s. Skies remain mostly clear.

What’s next? Even toastier Friday out ahead of an approaching cold front, with scattered showers and storms likely late. Cooler with shower potential this weekend, especially Sunday.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: It’s a warm evening, with temperatures slipping from the 80s into the 70s. Skies stay mostly clear overnight as lows settle in the low and mid-60s. Light winds continue from the south. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Friday): Mostly sunny in the morning, then increasing afternoon clouds. Winds from the south and southwest around 10 mph, with gusts near 20 mph, bring higher dew points (rising to the mid- and upper 60s by afternoon). That makes highs in the mid-80s to near 90 feel a bit hotter than that. There’s a chance of a shower or storm by late afternoon, mainly after 4 p.m. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Scattered showers, maybe a few storms, become more likely in the immediate area during the evening, perhaps lingering into the early overnight. One or two storms could deliver brief heavy rain, but none of the activity should last too long in any one place. Humidity drops off late as lows settle in the upper 50s to mid-60s. Confidence: Medium-High

A look ahead

Models remain somewhat mixed as to whether we’ll see scattered showers on Saturday as the front continues passing through the region, or if they will stay more to our south. Any showers we do see should mainly be light and focused on the morning, although they could linger later, especially in and around Southern Maryland. Staying mostly cloudy with much cooler highs around the mid- to upper 60s. Confidence: Low-Medium

Rain is looking like a good bet Sunday. Some uncertainty remains, mainly around how much falls and how far north the heavier activity gets. At least off-and-on showers seem likely, and it could rain much of the day, with highs around 60 to 65. Confidence: Medium

Warning up to around 70 on Monday as skies clear, but another cold front pushes through, bringing some of the most legitimate fall weather so far. Monday night lows dip to the 40s in many spots. Tuesday highs struggle to reach 60 despite sunshine, with Tuesday night lows in the 40s to perhaps upper 30s in the usual cold spots. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for October 1

A sharp early-season cold snap in 1899 set record lows and kicked off several consecutive chilly mornings, including one of the earliest near-freezing readings on record.

Today’s daily digit — 8/10: On the warm side, with highs well into the 80s. But we’re running low on warm days, so it's worth enjoying. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
